title_en: A young vojvoda comes from down there

lines.cyr: Оздола идат еден млад војвода,
lines.lat: Ozdola idat eden mlad vojvoda,
lines.en: A young vojvoda comes from down there,

lines.cyr: по него одат седум, осум души,
lines.lat: po nego odat sedum, osum duši,
lines.en: following him are seven, eight people,

lines.cyr: нане мила нане, седум, осум души.
lines.lat: nane mila nane, sedum, osum duši.
lines.en: granny, dear granny, seven, eight people.

lines.cyr: На рамо ми носат пушки малихери,
lines.lat: Na ramo mi nosat puški maliheri,
lines.en: On their shoulders they carry Mannlicher rifles,

lines.cyr: на гради ми носат чифте патрондаши,
lines.lat: na gradi mi nosat čifte patrondaši,
lines.en: on their chest they carry cartridges,

lines.cyr: на глава ми носет црни фес капчина,
lines.lat: na glava mi noset crni fes kapčina,
lines.en: on their heads they wear black fez hats,

lines.cyr: нане мила нане, црни фес шапчиња.
lines.lat: nane mila nane, crni fes šapčinja.
lines.en: granny, dear granny, black fez hats.

lines.cyr: Право ми тргет горе за Рашанец,
lines.lat: Pravo mi trget gore za Rašanec,
lines.en: They are headed straight up for Rashanec,

lines.cyr: првиот ми беше Аргир Маринче,
lines.lat: prviot mi beše Argir Marinče,
lines.en: the first one was Argir Marinche,

lines.cyr: вториот ми беше тој Васил Зимов,
lines.lat: vtoriot mi beše toj Vasil Zimov,
lines.en: the second one was Vasil Zimov,

lines.cyr: нане мила нане, тој Васил Зимов.
lines.lat: nane mila nane, toj Vasil Zimov.
lines.en: granny, dear granny, Vasil Zimov.

lines.cyr: Третиот ми беше Стеван Куртела,
lines.lat: Tretiot mi beše Stevan Kurtela,
lines.en: The third one was Stefan Kurtela,

lines.cyr: четвртиот ми беше Јанко Димитров,
lines.lat: četvrtiot mi beše Janko Dimitrov,
lines.en: the fourth one was Janko Dimitrov,

lines.cyr: нане мила нане, Јанко Димитров.
lines.lat: nane mila nane, Janko Dimitrov.
lines.en: granny, dear granny, Janko Dimitrov.

lines.cyr: Бог да го убие Вељан од Речица,
lines.lat: Bog da go ubie Veljan od Rečica,
lines.en: May God kill Veljan of Rechica,

lines.cyr: нане мила нане, Вељан од Речица
lines.lat: nane mila nane, Veljan od Rečica
lines.en: granny, dear granny, Veljan of Rechica,

lines.cyr: што ги предаде седум осум души
lines.lat: što gi predade sedum osum duši
lines.en: who betrayed seven, eight people,

lines.cyr: Седум осум души, сè млади момчина
lines.lat: Sedum osum duši, sè mladi momčina
lines.en: Seven, eight people, all young lads,

lines.cyr: се млади момчиња, сите Македонци
lines.lat: se mladi momčinja, site Makedonci
lines.en: all young lads, all Macedonians,

lines.cyr: нане мила нане, сите Македонци.
lines.lat: nane mila nane, site Makedonci.
lines.en: granny, dear granny, all Macedonians.
